meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商视频营销创作技能，支持多品类商品的营销视频脚本生成，包含6阶段创作流程、智能体提示词框架、8种商品类型模板，适用于电商平台、社交媒体、品牌推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成电商营销视频脚本，覆盖多品类商品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商商品快速生成营销视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Generate ecommerce marketing video scripts for multiple product categories
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create marketing video scripts for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，你给出商品信息，Claude 会按6阶段流程创作电商营销视频脚本：先收集商品信息、定义目标人群和风格，再提炼卖点，按“痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决”结构写脚本，并给出镜头、运镜与后期建议。
howto.when: 当你提出要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销专业指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个30秒自动喂食器的抖音视频脚本，面向25-35岁上班族。
say.note: 会按黄金叙事结构输出脚本和镜头建议。

say.text: 给智能厨电写个60秒视频脚本，风格科技感，突出AI一键烹饪。
say.note: 会包含产品展示和环绕运镜设计。

say.text: 写美妆护肤品的30秒营销视频，痛点写皮肤干燥暗沉。
say.note: 会输出痛点切入与产品展示的完整脚本。

howto.what_en: When given product info, Claude writes e-commerce video ad scripts via a 6-phase process: collect product info, define audience and style, extract selling points, then script with "pain point→product→solution", and add camera, movement, and post-production advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a marketing video script for a product or ask for e-commerce video marketing guidance.

say_en.text: Write a 30s Douyin script for an automatic pet feeder, targeting 25-35 office workers.
say_en.note: Outputs script with golden narrative and shot ideas.

say_en.text: Create a 60s smart kitchen appliance video, tech style, highlighting one-touch AI cooking.
say_en.note: Includes product showcase and orbit camera moves.

say_en.text: Write a 30s beauty product marketing video with dry, dull skin as the pain point.
say_en.note: Outputs full script with pain-point opening.
